name: iGEM RFC1000 Level-0 documented bodies and declared fusion sites
scope: Documented Level-0 part bodies only, with separately declared four-role fusion-site facts. Grammar accepts nonempty contiguous subpaths of the four roles; not full transcription-unit, vector or registry compliance.
limitations: Input sequence is exactly the documented part body: body_start=0 and body_end=sequence length. Empty additions are intentional; no external vector, clamp, spacer or Type IIS flank sequence is inferred.

Fusion sites are oriented 5-prime to 3-prime in the assembled reference strand, not reverse-complemented right-hand cohesive-end labels. Declared equality does not establish physical termini or cleavage.
The CDS body includes its initial ATG, which overlaps the last three bases of the AATG left fusion site; this checker never prepends a second ATG or reconstructs an assembled product.
Each input declares one of four roles; other subparts, tags, alternative plant syntax and Level-1 or higher overhangs are unsupported by this profile.

A single role or contiguous role subpath can pass these local constraints without forming a complete transcription unit. Functional roles, translation, expression, stop codons and host suitability are not verified.
Only BsaI and SapI internal sites are required absent. No additional forbidden-site recommendation, BioBrick RFC10 requirement or universal vector-format claim is inferred.
The rules are factual curation of the official live page reviewed 2026-11-28; no immutable upstream document version or raw-byte snapshot hash is asserted.
